draft.subject: Your API pagination question
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for your patience on your open ticket about the accounts endpoint — list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you don't need to fetch everything at once. Tariq will follow up there with the details.

Since our kickoff, the one thing I'd still nudge on is getting a real project started in Wrenfield — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything else on the API side.

Best,
Chidi
